blocs.texte: On utilise un vocabulaire spécifique pour décrire les maladies et les symptômes. L'anglais utilise aussi des expressions idiomatiques (idioms) liées à la santé.

lignes: to be sick as a dog

blocs.texte: 1) I'm feeling a bit under the weather today, I think I caught a cold. 2) She was sick as a dog last week, but now she's on the mend. 3) After two weeks of rest, he is as fit as a fiddle again.

blocs.enonce: Remplace les mots soulignés par une expression idiomatique équivalente : 1) I feel quite unwell today. 2) He is recovering well after his operation. 3) She is in excellent health after her holiday.
blocs.solution: 1) I feel under the weather today. 2) He is on the mend after his operation. 3) She is as fit as a fiddle after her holiday.

blocs.texte: La médecine moderne (modern medicine) utilise des médicaments et des technologies scientifiques, tandis que la médecine traditionnelle (traditional medicine) utilise des plantes et des remèdes transmis de génération en génération.

In Madagascar, many people use both modern and traditional medicine. When someone has a common illness, like a cold or a stomach ache, they often use traditional remedies first, such as herbal teas made from local plants. However, for more serious illnesses, people usually go to a hospital and see a doctor, who can use modern equipment and medicine to diagnose and treat the problem. Some people believe traditional medicine is gentler and has fewer side effects, while others trust modern medicine because it is based on scientific research. Both approaches have advantages, and many families combine them depending on the situation.

blocs.enonce: D'après le texte, réponds aux questions : 1) What do people often use first for common illnesses? 2) Where do people go for more serious illnesses? 3) Why do some people prefer traditional medicine? 4) Why do others trust modern medicine?
blocs.solution: 1) They often use traditional remedies, such as herbal teas. 2) They go to a hospital and see a doctor. 3) Because they believe it is gentler and has fewer side effects. 4) Because it is based on scientific research.

blocs.texte: En anglais, il existe des expressions spécifiques pour exprimer son accord total, son désaccord, ou un accord partiel avec une opinion.

lignes: I completely agree. / I totally agree. / That's exactly right. / Absolutely.
I disagree. / I don't think so. / I'm afraid I disagree. / That's not quite right.
I partly agree, but... / That's true, however... / I see your point, but... / Yes, but on the other hand...

blocs.texte: 1) A: Traditional medicine is always better than modern medicine. B: I disagree. Modern medicine has saved many lives thanks to scientific research. 2) A: Exercise is important for good health. B: I completely agree, it keeps the body strong. 3) A: Junk food is not dangerous if eaten occasionally. B: I partly agree, but it should still be limited.

blocs.enonce: Réagis à ces opinions en exprimant un accord total, un désaccord, ou un accord partiel (au choix) : 1) 'Sleeping 8 hours a night is essential for good health.' 2) 'You should never visit a doctor unless you are seriously ill.' 3) 'Drinking enough water every day improves health.'
blocs.solution: Réponses modèles : 1) I completely agree, sleep is very important for the body. 2) I disagree, regular check-ups can prevent serious illnesses. 3) I totally agree, water helps the body function properly.

blocs.texte: Un mode de vie sain repose sur plusieurs habitudes simples à adopter au quotidien.

blocs.titre: Conseils pour un mode de vie sain
blocs.texte: 1) Eat a balanced diet with fruits and vegetables. 2) Drink plenty of water every day. 3) Exercise regularly, at least 30 minutes a day. 4) Sleep at least 8 hours a night. 5) Avoid smoking and excessive alcohol. 6) Wash your hands regularly to prevent illness. 7) Manage stress through relaxation or hobbies.

You should drink at least two litres of water a day. You should also try to walk or exercise every day, even for a short time. You shouldn't skip meals, and you shouldn't stay up too late at night, because sleep is essential for your body to recover.

blocs.enonce: Écris 5 conseils (avec should/shouldn't) pour aider un ami à adopter un mode de vie plus sain.
blocs.solution: Réponse modèle : 1) You should eat more fruits and vegetables. 2) You should exercise at least three times a week. 3) You shouldn't eat too much junk food. 4) You should sleep at least 8 hours a night. 5) You shouldn't skip breakfast.

blocs.texte: Les pronoms relatifs permettent de relier deux phrases en évitant de répéter un nom. Ils introduisent une proposition relative qui donne plus d'informations sur ce nom.

lignes: The doctor who treated me was very kind.
The medicine which I took worked well.
The nurse that helped me was friendly.
The patient whose leg was broken is better now.
The doctor whom I saw yesterday is excellent.

blocs.texte: 1) This is the hospital which treats children. 2) I know a doctor who specializes in traditional medicine. 3) The woman whose son is sick is waiting at the pharmacy. 4) He is the specialist whom everyone recommends.

blocs.enonce: Complète avec le pronom relatif correct (who, which, whose, that, whom) : 1) The nurse ... helped me was very patient. 2) This is the medicine ... cured my headache. 3) I met a woman ... brother is a famous doctor. 4) He is the doctor ... I trust the most.

blocs.texte: La proposition conditionnelle de type 2 (if clause type 2) sert à exprimer une situation hypothétique, imaginaire ou peu probable dans le présent/futur, et sa conséquence imaginaire.

If + sujet + prétérit, sujet + would + base verbale. Exemple : If I were sick, I would see a doctor. Remarque : avec le verbe 'to be', on utilise 'were' pour tous les sujets (même I/he/she/it) dans un style soutenu, même si 'was' est parfois accepté à l'oral.

1) If I ate more vegetables, I would be healthier. 2) If she exercised regularly, she wouldn't feel tired all the time. 3) If we had more doctors in rural areas, people would get better healthcare. 4) If he stopped smoking, his health would improve.

blocs.enonce: Complète ces phrases hypothétiques avec le conditionnel type 2 : 1) If I ... (be) you, I ... (see) a doctor immediately. 2) If she ... (drink) more water, she ... (feel) better. 3) If they ... (eat) healthier food, they ... (not/be) overweight. 4) If we ... (have) a hospital nearby, it ... (be) easier to get treatment.
blocs.solution: 1) If I were you, I would see a doctor immediately. 2) If she drank more water, she would feel better. 3) If they ate healthier food, they would not be overweight. 4) If we had a hospital nearby, it would be easier to get treatment.
